item.title: Friday 14/8/26 1.20pm - Seven Lime and Forest commercial hire bikes obstructing the narrow, busy public footway corner and dropped kerb / visual disability tactile paving at the corner of Newlands Park and Venner Rd by Penge East Station / shops parade., 14th August
item.description:
Friday 14/8/26 1.20pm - Seven Lime and Forest commercial hire bikes obstructing the narrow, busy public footway corner and dropped kerb / visual disability tactile paving at the corner of Newlands Park and Venner Rd by Penge East Station / shops parade. The obstruction was even worse at about 6pm with 8 bikes forming a complete wall and forcing ablebodied, disabled, sighted, blind persons and patents with pushchairs etc into the busy crossroads carriageway. I am not reporting this to Lime and Forest as the obstructions continue day after day. This is not a one-off abandoned bicycle. I will not download both companies apps, scan barcides, fill in online forms etc. I'm not paid or volunteering to report badly parked bikes to commercial companies misusing and obstructing the public footway. Do not send me any hire bike company links. Please remove the obstructing commercial hire bikes asap so that the public can resume clear, safe access to cross the road here. After that, I leave it to the council / contractors to notify Forest and Lime that their bikes have been removed as public footway obstructions. I recommend fining them for this offence with an additional compound storage fee per day, per bike, perhaps on an equivalent scale to parking offences or littering (eg. £500 per offence) plus a release fee. It seems that not until fines are imposed will Forest and Lime and/or their customers stop dumping hire bikes here. .

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 210, Venner Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
